svg.title: AetherFlow v4.0.0 — Peer Clustering
svg.desc: Three independent AetherFlow v4.0.0 servers paired over a dedicated WireGuard afpeer0 mesh for delegated grants, NFSv4.2 storage federation, and remote Jellyfin 12.4 transcode offload.

g.text: 3 independent servers · dedicated WireGuard (afpeer0) · delegated grants · NFSv4.2 federation · Jellyfin 12.4 GPU offload
Active server switcher · AreaFence · local-only auth
Auto-stops mount on 2 sentinel fails or WG >180s
Local fallback: probes, net inputs, pre-start errors
Zero-Trust Pairing: 10-min HTTPS Invite + 6-Digit Verification Code
OS-CA TLS · SSRF guard · pinned WG keys · TCP 9443 & 2049 on afpeer0
Zero access by default (8 areas: none / read / write)
Independent Node · Media Vault & Managed Peer
afpeer0 mesh · B↔C media parity & grants
Independent Node · Jellyfin 12.4 GPU Transcode Worker
Mounts A transcode/tmp cache + binds shared media paths
Writes HLS segments straight back to A · SIGKILL on revoke
8 Delegated Grant Areas (Zero Access by Default)
Ports on afpeer0 only: TCP 9443 (API) · TCP 2049 (NFS)
Interior subfolder mount rule prevents empty-library wipes
15s health loop reconciles offline revocations & remounts
Every server stays independently operable if peers drop
